title: finding(skills): the objectui project-setup guide mounts app-shell's `ObjectView` as `<ObjectView objectName="contact" />` with none of its required props, so a verbatim copy crashes on first render
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a customer-published guide that teaches a mount that cannot work, with a named landing site. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`, from contract review `5874389538` on PR objectui#11010 (objectui#7483, out-of-diff finding). ⛔ Not graded here.

## What the guide teaches (objectui `main`)
`skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`, section "`@object-ui/app-shell` — minimal shell + renderers", imports `{ AppShell, ObjectView, AdapterProvider, MetadataProvider }` from `@object-ui/app-shell` and mounts `ObjectView` with `objectName="contact"` and nothing else (no router).

## Why it is wrong
- app-shell's `ObjectView` reads `dataSource`, `objects`, `onEdit` and `externalRefreshKey`. It has no `objectName` prop: the object comes from the route and is resolved against `objects`.
- **On base:** a verbatim copy threw on first render, because the outer wrapper calls `objects.find(...)` with no guard (dev report `5828686918`, class a).
- **Since PR objectui#11010 lands:** the declared `ConsoleObjectViewProps` makes the same mount a compile error (TS2322 on `objectName`, TS2739 for the missing `dataSource` / `objects` / `onEdit`).
- **No gate covers it:** `check:doc-snippets` compiles the app-shell README's `ObjectView` block, which PR objectui#11010 brings to the four props. It does not compile `skills/objectui/**`.

## Reach
This is the customer-published skill an AI reads when it sets up an objectui project, so the wrong mount is taught to exactly the producer that copies verbatim.

## Direction (for triage to grade)
Rewrite the mount to the four props, mirroring the app-shell README block PR objectui#11010 lands, and say that it runs under a router. Or point the guide at the README's block rather than restating it. `skills/**` is a governed surface, so the landing follows that lane's rules. Optionally, extend the snippet type-check to `skills/objectui/guides/*.md`, but that is a new gate, so ⛔ not without the maintainer naming it.

## Dedupe
A semantic search of objectui issues (project-setup guide, `ObjectView objectName`, skills app-shell mount) returned nothing on this.
